name: shared-clock-stops-refusing
why: the refusal is DOUBLED: setWorldMinutes carries the same `if (_sharedClock) return _sharedClock()` one level down, so removing advanceWorldMinutes's own early return changes nothing - the write still refuses and the same shared minute comes back. Worth knowing rather than contriving a pin for: the outer guard is belt-and-braces, not the law.

name: camp-goes-silent-again
a-refusal-loses-its-words
old: if (place.inTown) return { ok: false, text: SURVIVAL_USE_TEXT.campingTown };
new: if (place.inTown) return { ok: false, text: null };
